import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { Note, NoteId, NoteText } from "{{scope}}/notebook/domain";
import type { ListNotesStore } from "./list-notes.contract.ts";
import { ListNotesHandler } from "./list-notes.handler.ts";

class FakeListNotesStore implements ListNotesStore {
  constructor(private readonly notes: readonly Note[]) {}

  async findAll(): Promise<Note[]> {
    return [...this.notes];
  }
}

function note(raw: string): Note {
  const text = NoteText.parse(raw);
  if (!text.ok) throw new Error(text.error);
  return new Note(NoteId.generate(), text.value);
}

describe("ListNotesHandler", () => {
  test("lists every note the store holds, in its order", async () => {
    const notes = [note("First"), note("Second")];
    const listed = await new ListNotesHandler(new FakeListNotesStore(notes)).execute();
    expect(listed.map((n) => n.toJSON())).toEqual(notes.map((n) => n.toJSON()));
  });

  test("lists nothing when there are no notes", async () => {
    expect(await new ListNotesHandler(new FakeListNotesStore([])).execute()).toEqual([]);
  });
});
